latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – transform any article or text into a fully self-contained HTML infographic with strict user-controlled workflow.

- Converts articles, reports, blog posts, or pasted text into visually engaging infographics (timeline, statistics, comparison, etc.)
- Enforces a strict, multi-step confirmation process: outline, layout, style, illustrations, and output format must each be confirmed separately.
- Automatically analyzes content and recommends the most suitable infographic type.
- Produces distinctive, non-generic infographic designs with zero external dependencies and print-ready formatting.
- Supports optional SVG illustrations and flexible output (HTML and PNG).
